failure_reason: Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome impersonation) returned 403 'Restricted Access' on the Home shop hub and on later spot-checks -> escalated to tier (b). Tier (b) Playwright headed with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled succeeded initially (11 leaf category pages returned real rendered product counts) but the site's bot-detection then began returning 403 for the remaining ~35 leaf category pages within the same session; a fresh tier-(a) request to one of the blocked URLs also returned 403, confirming the wall covers both tiers for this host at this time. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was attempted per the escalation rule but the browser extension is not connected in this environment (tabs_context_mcp returned 'Browser extension is not connected'), so tier (c) was unavailable. Per STEP 1 rule 4, stopped chasing the block and used the data already captured; all other category rows are the confirmed website hierarchy (from the mega-nav / hub pages, which loaded successfully before the block) with qty=null and a MANUAL REVIEW flag where the leaf page's product-count could not be captured.
notes: ACCESS: tier (a) curl_cffi impersonate=chrome blocked (403 Restricted Access) on /shop/home/ and on a later spot-check -> escalated to tier (b) Playwright chromium headless=False with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled (headless alone also returned 403; headed bypassed it). Site is the Home department of the Williams-Sonoma Inc. multi-brand retailer (williams-sonoma.com); mega-menu top-level Home categories are New, Furniture, Outdoor, Bedding, Bath, Rugs, Lighting, Art & Decor, Pillows & Throws, Gifts, Sale, plus a Windows hub (home-windows) and the Home Essentials/homekeeping hub (kitchen + home storage + cleaning) reachable via a footer/cross-nav link, not the top mega-menu itself. TREE: built as the union of the mega-menu (Bedding, Bath, Rugs, Pillows & Throws, Windows, Homekeeping/Home Essentials hub pages) each page's own 'Shop by Category / Shop by Style / Shop by Material' sub-nav; Furniture, Outdoor furniture, Lighting, Art & Decor, and pure decorative/kitchenware/food/tabletop sections were scoped out (handled by other category workers or out of scope for Textile/Storage). QTY: preferred the rendered '[data-test-id=product-count-message]' header text (e.g. '42 Items') captured after scroll+hydration wait, per the instruction to prefer the rendered header over any structured/API count for Williams-Sonoma-family (Constructor.io) properties; raw SSR HTML never contains the count (it is populated client-side after mount), so tier (a) alone cannot supply qty even when not blocked. 11 leaf pages returned confirmed counts before the site began 403-blocking the automated session; the remaining leaf pages are recorded with qty=null and flag='MANUAL REVIEW: blocked (403) before quantity could be captured' - their existence/hierarchy/labels are still confirmed from the successfully-rendered hub/nav pages, only the per-page product count is missing. EXCLUDED: 'Soaps'/'Soaps, Lotions & Scents' (fragrance, not textile/storage), 'Bath Accessories' (site places it as its own bucket separate from Bath Towels/Robes/Mats & Shower Curtains -> non-textile hard accessories such as soap dishes/canisters, not primarily textile), 'Countertop Organization' group (Canisters, Utensil Holders, Fruit Bowls, Bread Boxes, Lazy Susans & Trays, Spoon Rests & Trivets, Paper Towel & Napkin Holders, Cookbook Holders - Kitchen & Dining / decorative boundary per storage.md SS24/SS26, not primarily storage), 'Cleaning' group (Cleaning Supplies, Vacuums & Mops, Trash/Recycling/Compost, Dish Racks & Brushes, Irons & Laundry, Ladders & Step Stools, Fans & Air Purifiers - tools/appliances, neither category), 'Rug Pads' (underlay accessory, not itself a textile floor covering, analogous to curtain hardware), 'Shop by Fabric' material-facet pages under Bedding (Percale/Cotton/Sateen/Linen - filters over the same Duvet/Sheet/Quilt products already counted, would double-count), all View All / All Bedding / All Rugs / All Pillows / All Throws / All Bath / All Kitchen Linens / All Floor Mats / All Kitchen & Home Storage / All Countertop Organization / All Cleaning / All Window Treatments links, Collaborations/brand-shop pages (Hill House, Josh Young, Morris & Co., Sanderson, Scalamandre, AERIN, Matouk), New Arrivals / Featured / In Stock / Free Shipping / Sale & Clearance filter links, Design Resources/guide articles, and Window Hardware (curtain rods etc, explicitly excluded per textile.md SS5). DUPLICATES: 'Sisal & Abaca Rugs' resolves to the identical URL as 'Natural Rugs' (/shop/home-rugs/natural-fiber-rugs/) - kept one row under 'Natural Rugs'; 'Doormats' is reachable both from Rugs > Shop by Category and from Homekeeping > Floor Mats and resolves to the same URL (/shop/homekeeping/homekeeping-kitchen-mat-doormat/) - kept once under Floor Mats.
